wall_semantics.native_elapsed_over_210: hold for individual exact-state/resource classification; no generic relaxation

all producer and independent small evidence/manifests

any separately enumerated old cap-control/failure clones already covered by independent manifests

mandatory_hold_after_run.required_next_action: independent full replay and a new cap/headroom review before any r1642 design

launch before a fresh input rehash and storage-floor check
run two rounds in one process
change source, binary, strategy, cap, wall, RSS, or watchdog implementation
